column1: # EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) -- Croatia residential indicators
# Used by 03_heat_intensity.py for (1) the unknown-cohort stock-weighted
# fallback intensity (stock_pct_hr column) and (2) the BSO reconciliation row.
# stock_pct_hr: share of the Croatian residential stock by construction cohort.
#   Croatia has a large socialist-era (1946-1990) multi-family stock.
#   Distribution approximated from the Croatian census and Odyssee-Mure Croatia.
#   heat intensity (delivered). DERIVED from the Slovenian-proxy TABULA
#   per-cohort class-average space-heating need x climate multiplier (0.8161)
#   x retrofit blend (0.953) + DHW. The EU Building Stock Observatory portal
#   could not be queried directly; flagged as derived
# Source: Croatian census; Odyssee-Mure Croatia; Slovenian-proxy TABULA
